messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

After a claim is registered, it is examined by a claims officer. The claims officer then writes a settlement recommendation. This recommendation is then checked by a senior claims officer who may mark the claim as OK or Not OK. If the claim is marked as Not OK, it is sent back to the claims officer and the recommendation is repeated. If the claim is OK, the claim handling process proceeds.

<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

      </lane>
      <lane id="Lane_SeniorClaimsOfficer" name="Senior Claims Officer">
        <flowNodeRef>Task_CheckRecommendation</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>Gateway_OKCheck</flowNodeRef>
        <flowNodeRef>EndEvent_ClaimHandled</flowNodeRef>
      </lane>

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_ClaimRegistered" name="Claim Registered">
      <outgoing>Flow_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <task id="Task_ExamineClaim" name="Examine Claim">

      <outgoing>Flow_2</outgoing>

      <outgoing>Flow_4</outgoing>

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_OK" name="OK" sourceRef="Gateway_OKCheck" targetRef="EndEvent_ClaimHandled" />
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotOK" name="Not OK" sourceRef="Gateway_OKCheck" targetRef="Task_WriteRecommendation" />
